summary: Iter 12: Full backend + frontend testing of typing indicators, message reactions (add/toggle/replace/invalid/403 not-in-thread), Feed Composer role-gating + kind whitelist + image upload readiness, Home feed pickup of new artist posts, and PWA assets (manifest.json, service-worker.js, icons). 14/14 backend pytest passing; all frontend UI flows verified in browser with real registered artist + buyer sessions.
critical_code_review_comments: messages.py: _other_typing compares expires_at (ISO string) with now_iso() lexicographically — works while both are UTC ISO with the same offset (+00:00 / Z consistency). Current now_iso is presumably UTC ISO; keep it that way. Consider using a MongoDB TTL index on db.typing.expires_at (as a date) instead of a string compare for automatic cleanup.

messages.py react() removes any prior emoji from user then adds new one — correct 'one reaction per user' semantics per spec. No count is stored per emoji; frontend computes counts from reactions list. Fine for small threads; O(N) per read.

service-worker.js: install pre-caches only '/' and '/manifest.json'. The main JS/CSS bundles get cached later via stale-while-revalidate on first visit. Offline first-load will fail; acceptable per current scope (no VAPID push server anyway).
index.js registers SW only on https — good. Note: no unregister/upgrade path if CACHE_VERSION changes; bumping version will still clean old caches via activate handler which is present. OK.
Frontend Messages.js reactions UI: relies on hover to reveal react-btn — on touch devices there's no hover so the button may never appear. Consider tap-to-reveal on mobile.
HomeFeed composer only shows for role artist/admin — verified. Buyer sees neither prompt, open button, nor mobile FAB. Good.
test_credentials: Uses /api/auth/register to create isolated per-test users (TEST_iter12_*@t.com); admin creds unused.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates ephemeral artist+buyer+message. Frontend flow created 1 studio_post via composer, 1 message + reactions, and typing state. All prefixed with TEST_iter12.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token localStorage key is 'hom_token' (NOT 'token'). Backend register response key is 'token' (NOT 'access_token'). Follow endpoint is /api/users/{id}/follow (social router is mounted at /api). /api/feed/home returns {following_count, items:[...]} — items live under 'items'. Reactions require hover to reveal react-btn on desktop; mobile may need tap-only reveal. Everything in iter 12 works end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iter 12 scope.
